events.title: Stand Up Stand Out
events.summary: Get ready for an epic afternoon as Auckland's best secondary school emerging artists battle it out in the Finals of Stand Up Stand Out 2026. Following a competition that saw more than 2,000 students take part from across the region, the top finalists are going to showcase their talents across six performance categories in front of a live audience and expert judges. From powerful vocals and dynamic dance routines to outstanding original performances, this is your chance to see the future stars of Auckland. Plus, enjoy a special performance from the Stand Up Stand Out Alumni Band. Celebrate the talent, creativity and passion of our rangatahi. Stand Up Stand Out aka SUSO is an Auckland Council-delivered programme for Tāmaki Makaurau Auckland secondary school music and dance students. SUSO has its roots in the Ōtara community, originally conceived by local college students who advocated for an arts centre that became Ōtara Music Arts Centre (OMAC) over 30 years ago. SUSO was a foundation programme at OMAC and has been an annual fixture servicing the wider region of Tāmaki ever since. Each year, over 1,500 participants from up to 50+ secondary schools around Auckland come together to perform across 13 events in one of the six categories: Solo Vocal, Group Vocal, Solo Instrumental, Band, Dance and Originals. events.title: An Evening with Damon Hill
events.summary: In an era when motorsports can feel manufactured and scripted, Damon Hill represents authenticity. The 1996 FIA Formula 1 World Drivers’ Champion Damon Hill is one of the sport’s most respected figures, remembered for his thrilling battles with Michael Schumacher and for partnering with the late Ayrton Senna at Williams in 1994. In conversation with Tom Clarkson – acclaimed host of the official F1 podcast Beyond The Grid – Damon will share stories from his remarkable Formula 1 journey, from his unconventional late entry into the sport aged 32 to becoming the first son of a champion to claim the title himself. Hear first-hand what it was like to pilot those legendary Williams cars and the inside stories from his epic battles with Schumacher. But this isn’t just a trip down memory lane. Damon will also turn his expert eye to the present. Which current drivers and cars impress him the most? And what might be coming next for F1? Plus, he’ll be taking your questions so come prepared to quiz one of F1’s most insightful voices. Damon remains a symbol of authenticity in motorsport, proof that champions can be both fierce competitors and true gentlemen. Join us for an evening that celebrates both F1’s golden past and its exciting future.

events.title: Four Last Songs
events.summary: The sensuous, glittering raptures of the Rosenkavalier Suite evoke the decadence of 18th century Vienna in a dazzling array of complex waltzes. Then delve deeper into Richard Strauss’ most personal, revealing and achingly beautiful music with his sublime Four Last Songs. In music that plays between light and shadow, the work takes on as its organising motto frei aber froh — free but happy.

events.title: NZTrio He Taonga Wairere
events.summary: An intimate journey exploring devotion, memory, and the intersection between joy and sorrow with a performance of LOVE AND LOSS. Edvard Grieg’s Andante con moto begins the concert: a deep, solemn movement, the sole fragment of an unfinished trio, it is an intense meditation on loss and profound melancholy. Sorrow gives way to the breathless excitement of courtship and tantalising romance of Claire Cowan’s Subtle Dances, before Robert Schumann finishes with brilliant, joyful devotion in Piano Trio No. 2 in F Major. Written shortly after his long-awaited marriage to Clara, this sunlit masterpiece is filled with the effusive affection of a besotted husband, a beautiful "luminous image" of love realised. Described as a “national treasure” (NZ Herald), NZTrio He Taonga Wairere is renowned for its eclectic repertoire, outstanding talent and warm kiwi stage presence. Bringing together three incredibly accomplished artists: Amalia Hall (violin), Matthias Balzat (cello) & Somi Kim (piano), every NZTrio performance powerfully reaffirms the importance and cathartic nature of a live musical experience in today’s digital world. This performance is part of the Auckland Live Morning Melodies 2026 season. events.title: Talk | Why Go? Thoughts and Reflections from the Learning from Venice Workshop
events.summary: Since 2005, when et al.’s the fundamental practice was first presented at the Venice Biennale, amid heated debate, there have been ongoing conversations about Aotearoa’s place at this major international contemporary art event. What do we bring to Venice? How do we represent ourselves? And what value does participation bring to Aotearoa’s artists and wider visual arts community? Join participants from the 2026 Learning from Venice Workshop for a forum at Auckland Art Gallery Toi o Tāmaki. This group travelled to Venice in May 2026, where they studied Biennale projects, gained new insights into and developed fresh thinking about this long-established institution. They will share what they saw and learned, and consider Aotearoa’s evolving relationship with the Venice Biennale. The conversation will also ask bigger questions about whether Aotearoa should be represented at the Biennale and how that representation might take shape. The forum will be introduced by Natasha Conland, curator of the fundamental practice and the conversation will be led by Learning from Venice co-leaders Christina Barton and Hanahiva Rose. Together with programme participants, they will reflect on, test and offer new thinking on what has become an established but contested part of New Zealand’s international strategy for the visual arts. There will be an opportunity for audience Q&A at the end of the talk. The talk is free, but spaces are limited. Please book to avoid disappointment. Feel free to come earlier and explore the fundamental practice before the Gallery closes at 5pm. Then head to the Clock Tower doors, which open from 5pm for the 5:30pm talk in the Auditorium. This programme is presented in partnership with OCAA, The Chartwell Trust, and Elam Fine Arts, Waipapa Taumata Rau University of Auckland.

events.title: Britten War Requiem
events.summary: Few works confront the tragedy of war with such scope and intensity as Benjamin Britten’s War Requiem. Written for the 1962 consecration of Coventry Cathedral – rebuilt after its destruction in World War II – it stands as one of the twentieth century’s most ambitious choral masterpieces. Britten interweaves the Latin Mass for the Dead with the piercing poetry of Wilfred Owen, who was killed in the final week of World War I. In doing so, Britten creates a dialogue between the sacred and the human, between acts of faith and the realities of futility. Scored for soprano, tenor, and baritone soloists, two orchestras, children’s choir, and large symphonic chorus, the War Requiem is both monumental in scale and deeply personal in message. From its haunting opening to its final plea for peace, the work remains a searing reminder of the cost of conflict and the enduring hope for reconciliation. Auckland Choral is joined by the Auckland Youth Choir and Cantare Choir of Westlake Girls in this powerful presentation of Britten’s visionary masterpiece.

events.title: Diwali | Talk: The epics and their others
events.summary: Part of our Diwali celebrations, join us for a panel discussion with curator Balamohan Shingade in conversation with Tāmaki Makaurau-based artists whose practices draw on the epic stories, mythologies and histories of South Asia. The panel discussion will feature artist talks and retellings of episodes from epics such as the Ramayana and Mahabharata. The artists will talk about how their own practice is influenced by mythology and storytelling and how our inherited cultural stories can evolve and change through artistic expression. Participants will explore what happens when familiar stories are approached through marginalised viewpoints, including queer and feminist, Indigenous and anti-caste, and diasporic perspectives. events.title: Reverie
events.summary: Described as a “national treasure” (NZ Herald), NZTrio He Taonga Wairere is renowned for its eclectic repertoire, outstanding talent and warm kiwi stage presence. Any preconceptions of classical music being stuffy or intimidating are smashed by edgy repertoire, venue ambiance, and post-concert manaakitanga. Bringing together three incredibly accomplished artists: Amalia Hall (violin), Matthias Balzat (cello) & Somi Kim (piano), every NZTrio performance powerfully reaffirms the importance and cathartic nature of a live musical experience in today’s digital world. Reverie opens with a mesmerizing, atmospheric work that gently rocks between dream and reality - Hanna Kulenty’s A Cradle Song - before entering a state of Romantic fervour with Schumann’s Piano Trio No. 3, brimming with lyrical expression. Adam Schoenberg’s Las Estrellas highlights shimmering textures and celestial inspiration, while a new commission from Karlo Margetič offers a fresh and distinctive New Zealand perspective. Finally, Leonard Bernstein’s youthful Piano Trio provides a taste of his early brilliance and quirky personality, foreshadowing the irrepressible energy of his later Broadway compositions. events.title: Courtney Barnett
events.summary: Aussie legend Courtney Barnett has announced her Creature of Habit New Zealand tour dates for November. More than five years since her last sold-out New Zealand tour, the Grammy-nominated singer-songwriter will bring her live show to Aotearoa, celebrating her newly released fourth studio album 'Creature of Habit’. Courtney makes returns to Aotearoa in the wake of extensive UK and North American dates. Known for a performance that’s part intimate storytelling, part indie rock, with bursts of raw grunge-like energy, Courtney Barnett live is genuine and authentic. A signature blend of moody guitar, witty, anecdotal lyrics and her laconic talk-singing have cemented her as “one of the most distinctive voices in indie music” (The Mancunion). Released in March, Creature of Habit is the highly anticipated new album from the indie trailblazer. It’s a bold, emotionally resonant record that explores the central question: how to get out of your own way so you can truly feel your life. Written in the wake of a relocation from Australia to Los Angeles and the closure of her long-running label Milk! Records, Barnett was grappling with changes that put the future of both her life and career in question. Rather than internalizing those feelings, she decided to bring all this swirling confusion directly into the recording process. With singles ‘Stay in Your Lane’, and ‘Site Unseen (feat. Waxahatchee)’ setting the tone, the album marks a decisive new chapter in Courtney Barnett’s musical evolution.

events.title: All of This is Us 2026
events.summary: All Together Now choir returns to the Great Hall for a second year, bringing a vibrant, uplifting evening of choral music in support of Auckland City Mission – Te Tāpui Atawhai. Be part of something special as Aotearoa's largest choir network takes the stage with a dynamic set of around 20 songs — from international favourites like Sam Smith's "The Lighthouse Keeper" and John Lennon's "Imagine," to moving waiata "E Rere Te Manu," "Te Aroha," and more. Founded in 2021 by composer and conductor Kate Bell, All Together Now runs seven non-auditioned choirs across Auckland and Taupō, welcoming singers of every level — from absolute beginners to seasoned performers. With 400 members rehearsing weekly under professional conductors, this is community singing at its very best. Kate shares: "Last year's concert sold out, and it reminded us just how much people crave moments of real connection and community. This year we've poured even more heart into the programme — it's a celebration of the power of group singing to uplift and bring hope, a chance to share the aroha with Tāmaki Makaurau. And it's thrilling for us all that the thing we love to do can raise so much money to help the Mission continue its life-changing work. Come join us for a night of connection, community — and a great cause."

events.title: Eric Idle
events.summary: Join legendary comedian Eric Idle as he sits down to tell his incredible life’s story, live on stage and in conversation across Australia and New Zealand, like you’ve never heard it before. He’ll take you from the giddy heights of Monty Python to the trauma of his childhood: the highs and bitter lows behind one of the most beloved and celebrated actors and writers of all time. After losing his father at Christmas 1945, Idle spent twelve years in boarding schools before he escaped to Cambridge, fell in with five other troublemakers, and changed comedy forever. Always Look on the Bright Side of Life became Britain’s favourite funeral song. The Rutles became the world’s first mockumentary, George Harrison mortgaged his house to fund Life of Brian, and a medieval coconut gag became Spamalot, a Tony Award–winning Best Musical. Expect candid memories of the friends he has loved and lost – Graham Chapman, George Harrison, Robin Williams – alongside fortunes made and squandered, feuds and reunions, a brush with cancer, and why, at 83, he is still looking on the bright side of life. Unscripted, in conversation, and with the chance to put your own questions to him live on stage, An Evening of Idle Conversation is sixty years of show business told the way only Eric Idle can tell it. In celebration of his brand-new memoir, Idle in Provence: A Brief History of Thyme, copies will be available at each event, with signings where possible. Eric Idle is a comedian, actor, author, and singer-songwriter who found immediate fame with the sketch-comedy series Monty Python’s Flying Circus. The group’s films include Monty Python and the Holy Grail, Life of Brian, and The Meaning of Life. Eric wrote, directed, and created The Rutles: All You Need Is Cash, the world’s first mockumentary, and the Tony Award–winning musical Spamalot. events.title: Cat Power - The Greatest 20th Anniversary Tour
events.summary: Twenty years on, The Greatest still sounds like midnight. This summer, Cat Power returns to New Zealand for a run of special shows performing her seminal 2006 album The Greatest in full, alongside songs spanning one of the most singular catalogues in contemporary music. Recorded in Memphis with members of the legendary Hi Rhythm section, The Greatest remains a defining statement from Marshall: smoky, soulful and heartbreakingly intimate. Featuring enduring tracks including “The Greatest”, “Living Proof” and “Lived in Bars”, the album cemented Cat Power as one of the most influential voices of her generation. To mark the album’s 20th anniversary, these rare performances will revisit the record front to back, a chance to experience its quiet power, emotional depth and timeless beauty in the live setting it deserves. There are few artists who can hold a room the way Cat Power can. Experience the magic of The Greatest and re-enter the orbit of the early millennium in these raw, hypnotic shows in November.

events.summary: To celebrate the summer, the much-loved Royal New Zealand Ballet production from 2011 returns: Greg Horsman’s fairytale version of The Sleeping Beauty. events.title: The Blackout
events.summary: 'The Blackout' follows a group of kids who, after reaching breaking point with their parents’ addictions to their phones, decide to take matters into their own hands and blow up the internet! The world is thrown into a full BLACKOUT. Phones die, screens go offline, and suddenly everyone is forced to figure out how to live without the technology they have become completely dependent on. At first, it feels almost magical - neighbours connect, kids play outside, families spend real time together and old-school ways of living make a comeback. But the longer The Blackout continues, the more complicated things become. Businesses scramble, systems fail, people lose jobs and the world begins to realise just how much it relies on the internet to function. Through the good, the bad, and everything in between, the kids find themselves at the centre of a high-profile trial: did they cause complete chaos, or force the world to confront something it desperately needed to see? Laced with humour, heart and high-energy dance, 'The Blackout' takes the audience on a wild journey through a world forced to disconnect. When the screens go dark and the noise disappears, what really matters? Neverland Studios is proud to bring our 19th original show to life this December. events.title: Handel's Messiah
events.summary: For more than 170 years, Auckland Choral’s annual performance of Handel’s Messiah has been a cornerstone of the city’s festive season. Since its first performance in Dublin in 1742, this extraordinary oratorio has inspired audiences worldwide with its enduring message of hope, renewal, and joy. Originally composed for Easter, Messiah has become inseparable from Christmas celebrations, its majestic choruses and expressive arias capturing the spirit of the season like no other work. From the triumph of the “Hallelujah” Chorus to the tender beauty of “I Know That My Redeemer Liveth”, Handel’s music continues to unite generations in shared wonder and reflection. Performed in the grandeur of the Auckland Town Hall, this cherished tradition brings together choir, orchestra, and soloists in a stirring celebration of music and community. Join Auckland Choral as we honour this tradition and experience the enduring power of one of the greatest masterpieces ever written.

events.title: Love Actually in Concert
events.summary: Funny, irresistible and heart-warming, Love Actually is set in contemporary London in the weeks before Christmas and tells one story which weaves together a spectacular amount of love stories – sometimes romantic, sometimes sad, sometimes stupid – all funny in their own way. Now a Christmas tradition for many, Love Actually in Concert gives New Zealand audiences a new way to experience the film: a full, live orchestra will perform Craig Armstrong’s evocative score at these shows, with the film being projected onto the big screen. Everywhere you look it seems love is causing chaos. From the new bachelor Prime Minister who falls in love 30 seconds after entering Downing Street to a loser sandwich delivery guy who doesn’t have a hope with the girls in the UK so heads for Wisconsin; from a jilted writer who escapes the south of France to nurse his broken heart to an aging rock star trying to make a comeback at any price;, from a bride having problems with her husband’s best man to a married woman having trouble with her husband; from a schoolboy with a crush on the prettiest girl in the school to his architect step-father with a crush on Claudia Schiffer. The film features an all-star ensemble cast, including Hugh Grant, Liam Neeson, Colin Firth, Laura Linney, Bill Nighy, Martine McCutcheon, Alan Rickman, Emma Thompson, Keira Knightley Rowan Atkinson, Martin Freeman, and many more. Take a breathtaking tour of love’s delightful twists and turns as you fall under the spell of Love Actually and share in the laughs and charm live in concert.

events.title: Air Supply
events.summary: “We love coming back to Australia to where it all started” Russell Hitchcock. After five sold out shows across Australia last year, Air Supply are returning to bring the Air Supply love to the cities that missed out. Graham Russell and Russell Hitchcock met on 12 May 1975 during rehearsals for Jesus Christ Superstar. They return in December to celebrate 50 Years of wonderful hits including all-time classics such as “Love and Other Bruises”, “All Out Of Love”, “The One That You Love” and of course “Lost In Love”. If it’s true that practice makes perfect, then Graham and Russell –beloved by their millions of fans across the planet as Air Supply – have had nearly half a century to hone their skills, harness their passion and unleash the beautifully intimate yet rockin’ romantic energy of those instantly identifiable 80s hits that made them global superstars. Over their amazing 50-year career AIR SUPPLY have achieved success after success, with so much amazing music still to come for their staunch legion of fans. “Making Love Out Of Nothing At All”, “Now And Forever”, “Sweet Dreams” … these are songs that mean so much to so many, and Russell and Graeme will be joined by their stellar band to present the songs the fans love, in an amazing show that will be one to remember forever. When “Lost in Love” was released in Australia in October 1976, it quickly soared to the top of the charts and went on to be named Song of the Year in 1980. Seven consecutive Top 5 singles at that time equaled The Beatles’ run. AIR SUPPLY’s albums Lost in Love, The One That You Love, Now & Forever, and The Greatest Hits have since sold in excess of 40 million copies. In 2010 Graham was honoured with a BMI Million-Air Certificate recognizing three million performances of “All Out Of Love.” The duo is ever-present on the road to the tune of 130 dates a year and hit a milestone 5500th live show in late 2024. events.title: The Sweet Caroline Tour
events.summary: The Sweet Caroline Tour: A Tribute to Neil Diamond is a celebration of one of the most enduring songbooks in popular music history - an era when songs were written with heart, soul and honesty, and melodies stayed with you for a lifetime. This outstanding live production recreates that feeling in the most authentic way possible, with a full live band, powerful backing vocalists and a frontman whose voice and presence capture the unmistakable spirit of Neil Diamond. From iconic stadium anthems to deeply loved classics, every performance is delivered with energy, respect and a deep love for the music. Hear all the timeless hits: ‘Sweet Caroline’, ‘Song Sung Blue’, ‘Red Red Wine’, ‘Cracklin’ Rosie’, ‘Forever in Blue Jeans’, ‘Cherry Cherry’, ‘Crunchy Granola Suite’, ‘Shilo’, ‘Solitary Man’, ‘Kentucky Woman’, ‘I Am… I Said’, ‘Holly Holy’, ‘Soolaimon’ and more. events.title: An Evening with Guenther Steiner
events.summary: Guenther Steiner has always been Formula 1's most refreshing voice: far more likely to be censored by the broadcasters than to censor himself. The breakout star of Drive to Survive, a team boss whose charm and no-bull honesty won him millions of fans around the globe, is back on stage with his new live show “No Team Orders”, just days after the chequered flag falls on the most divisive season in a generation. A radical new technical formula, new teams on the grid, and ambitious young talent challenging the veterans for primacy: 2026 rewrote Formula 1, and the dust will barely have settled when Guenther lands in town. Few people are better placed to unpack the season than Guenther Steiner. Who really mastered the new rules? Which rookie proved the genuine article? Will more Grands Prix be cancelled? Is Christian Horner really coming back in 2027? You can also take the opportunity to ask your own questions of Guenther in the live audience Q&A. One night of infectiously funny candour with motorsport's most quotable man, serving the laughs and inside lines that will make you the most entertaining F1 expert at every Christmas party. Guenther began in rallying, working with greats like Carlos Sainz Snr and Colin McRae, ran Jaguar Racing in F1, built Red Bull's NASCAR programme in the United States, and was handpicked to create the Haas F1 Team from the ground up. In 2025 he changed gears again, leading the consortium that acquired the Red Bull KTM Tech3 MotoGP team, where he now serves as CEO.

events.title: Joe Jackson
events.summary: Joe Jackson, the singular singer-songwriter and pianist behind some of pop’s most enduring hits, is heading to New Zealand for the first time in almost two decades. The tour announce coincides with the recent release of his engaging new album Hope and Fury – out now! “Hello cruel world / I’m not going away / So I might as well have my say,” sings Joe Jackson on his new album “Hope and Fury”. And there’s no doubt that at a moment when many of his contemporaries have lost their passion, their talent, their voices or even their lives, Jackson continues to go from strength to strength. “Hope and Fury” continues his rich musical tapestry, delivering a masterful blend of provoking reinvention alongside a haven of familiarity, resulting in one of his strongest albums yet. Since bursting onto the scene at the turn of the 1980s, Jackson has built one of the most distinctive catalogues in popular music, scoring chart success with many classics such as “Is She Really Going Out with Him?”, “Steppin’ Out”, “Real Men”, among a comprehensive collection of acclaimed albums that have surprised and delighted throughout his career. A restless and inventive performer, Jackson remains one of the great live acts of his generation - a witty, sharp-tongued bandleader equally at home behind the piano as he is fronting a full band, and an artist whose catalogue spans new wave, rock, jazz, classical and pop without ever losing its distinctly English wit. Joe Jackson began his current world tour in May 2026, starting in the United States and Canada, receiving acclaim from fans and critics alike. Fans can expect a set that draws on Jackson’s most beloved hits, deep-cut favourites from across his 40-year plus career, sitting alongside selections from Hope and Fury. It will be an evening of what Joe Jackson describes as ‘playing the songs people love, alongside the ones that still surprise me.’ “Jackson shows impressive range throughout the night and his keyboard skills remain sharp… a satisfyin…

events.title: Sienna Spiro
events.summary: “SIENNA SPIRO [is] the world’s next pop vocal superhero… One of the greatest voices of her generation[,] she’s likely to be entertaining us for decades to come.” – VARIETY Show-stopping London-born singer and songwriter SIENNA SPIRO announces her global My House Tour, including debut headline Australian and New Zealand shows in January 2027. Said SIENNA, “I truly can’t wait for this tour. This is the biggest I’ve ever done and we’re going to perform in places I’ve never been before! I’m so excited to see you all and sing the songs from Visitor with you.” SIENNA has been winning audiences over across the globe, the recent US leg of her tour stirring up rave reviews, including from Variety, who dubbed SIENNA “one of the greatest voices of her generation” and Los Angeles Times, who professed that her voice, “might be the most impressive instrument to come out of England since Adele emerged nearly two decades ago.” Amassing over 1.2 billion global streams, and with close to 28 million monthly listeners on Spotify alone, SIENNA SPIRO is here to stay. After entering the year shortlisted for the BRIT Awards’ highly esteemed Critics’ Choice for 2026 award, 20-year-old SIENNA landed on Forbes' latest 30 Under 30 list, received two 2026 American Music Award nominations for Best Vocal Performance and Breakthrough Pop Artist, and garnered critical acclaim from Rolling Stone, Dazed, LA Times, V Magazine, The New York Times, The Hollywood Reporter and more.

events.title: An Evening with David Sedaris
events.summary: A savant of razor-sharp and sardonic wit, an evening with David Sedaris is better than therapy, a life affirming joyful experience that leaves a person feeling as if their cup has been filled right to the brim by one of the world's pre-eminent humour writers. Expect brand new essays and freshly minted diary entries read live from the stage, a candid audience Q&A, and an extended book signing that — true to form — will run as long as it needs to. In The Land and Its People, his first new essay collection since Happy-Go-Lucky, Sedaris reflects on what it means to be a foreigner, a brother, and a lifelong friend — trying on the role of caretaker after his partner Hugh's hip-replacement surgery. Equal parts tender and devastating, it's classic Sedaris: the kind of writing that makes you laugh until you feel guilty, then laugh again anyway. Don't miss the opportunity to hear David Sedaris read from his brand-new book.

events.summary: Frontier Touring is excited to announce the return of high-octane, GRAMMY®-nominated Icelandic rockers KALEO, bringing their celebrated Way Down Under We Go Tour to Australia and New Zealand in February. Kicking their latest world tour off with a 28-date run across North America this month, for a band whose music has travelled far beyond the borders of their homeland, KALEO’s rise has been remarkable. Since forming in Mosfellsbær (a suburb of Reykjavik) back in 2012, vocalist and guitarist JJ Julius Son, drummer David Antonsson, bassist Daniel Kristjansson and guitarist Rubin Pollock have built a catalogue that sits comfortably between blues-rock muscle, folk introspection and arena-sized hooks. What began as a local Icelandic phenomenon became a worldwide one with the release of 2016’s A/B, the breakthrough album that delivered enduring singles including ‘Way Down We Go’, ‘All The Pretty Girls’ and ‘No Good’. The numbers tell part of the story. KALEO have since amassed more than six billion global streams and over 70 international Gold, Platinum and Diamond certifications. No strangers to the world’s biggest stages, their live résumé includes appearances at festivals such as Coachella, Lollapalooza and Bonnaroo, along with sold-out headline tours across North America, Europe and beyond. With four studio albums to their name including 2025’s Mixed Emotions, KALEO are also one of the most synced bands of all time. Few songs have left a mark quite like ‘Way Down We Go’, which has amassed close to four billion streams worldwide and become a cultural phenomenon, appearing in millions of TikTok videos and countless film, television and advertising campaigns. KALEO have also featured prominently in major series including Yellowstone, The Morning Show, Grey’s Anatomy, Law & Order and Suits, alongside EA Sports franchises such as FIFA, Madden NFL and NHL. The band's latest chapter arrives in the wake of the A/B 10th Anniversary Deluxe Edition, released in June 2026. Expand…

events.summary: UK pop legends ABC have announced their very first New Zealand tour, with a concert at The Civic, Auckland on Thursday 4 March. The tour is proudly presented by Plus1 and The Breeze. Showcasing the hits songs ‘Tears Are Not Enough’, ‘Poison Arrow’, ‘The Look Of Love’ and ‘All Of My Heart’. A ground-breaking collection of modern love songs. With a majestic production from the legendary Trevor Horn it remains a classic to this day. Voted by many as the best British album of the decade.

events.title: Miss Saigon
events.summary: Nominated for an incredible number of Olivier, Tony and Drama Desk Awards, Miss Saigon is the second massively successful offering from the creators of Les Misérables, Claude-Michel Schönberg and Alain Boublil. Almost 40 years since taking the West End by storm, this tragedy of passion and beauty is re-imagined in this stunning concert production coming to the Aotea Centre in 2027. In the turmoil of the Vietnam War, Chris, an American soldier, and Kim, a Vietnamese girl, fall in love and marry but are distressingly separated when Saigon falls. As years pass, Chris, unable to contact Kim, remarries and attempts to move on with his life. Kim, however, gives birth to Chris' son and waits faithfully for Chris' return. This tender and tense tale is of a mother prepared to make the ultimate sacrifice for the sake of her son, an American soldier conflicted with the traumatic remnants of war, and the Engineer, a pimp and survivor who yearns for a super-sized life beyond Vietnam with his own “American Dream”. This semi-staged concert series features some of New Zealand’s finest musical theatre talent, a local orchestra and a choir of forty. With an epic score including “I’d Give My Life For You”, “Why God Why”, “Bui Doi” and “The Movie In My Mind”, Miss Saigon is a theatrical event not to be missed.

Last month, Arthur also took to the main stage at Reading & Leeds Festival, consolidating his reputation as a standout performer ahead of this expansive live endeavour. Since emerging as a content creator – with over 1.7 million TikTok followers, 85.4M likes on the app, and 27.6M YouTube views – Arthur Hill has established himself as an artist in his own right. His two 2025 EPs, ‘Missed Again’ and ‘In The Middle of Somewhere’, introduced his distinctive blend of witty lyricism, infectious pop, and genuine emotional honesty, while his growing live presence has seen him progress from an emerging artist to a headline performer.
